name: @react-bulk/mcp

tools.name: rbk_get_core_usage_guide
tools.description: Start here. How React Bulk works: Box as the base of every component, the spacing/gap/size/color rules, responsive and platform-specific styling, and the core components.

tools.name: rbk_get_style_aliases
tools.description: Every style alias (e.g. mx -> marginHorizontal, maxw -> maxWidth) with how its value is transformed (spacing multiplier, true = 100%, theme colors…), the style rules, and every style prop accepted by Box.

tools.name: rbk_search_docs
tools.description: Search React Bulk docs by text and platform.

tools.name: rbk_list_components
tools.description: List every component exported by @react-bulk/web and @react-bulk/native, with its doc (if any).

tools.name: rbk_get_component_api
tools.description: Return component props/events/styles/defaults and examples from docs.

tools.name: rbk_get_doc
tools.description: Return the full markdown of a docs page (or one "## section" of it), by slug, title or exported name.

tools.name: rbk_get_hook_api
tools.description: Return docs, import path and usage for a React Bulk hook (e.g. useTheme, useToaster).

tools.name: rbk_get_type
tools.description: Return the TypeScript definition (and docs, if any) of a public React Bulk type (e.g. RbkStyle, ButtonProps).

tools.name: rbk_get_theme_schema
tools.description: Return the theme schema (ThemeProps), default values and color tokens used by React Bulk.

tools.name: rbk_generate_component_snippet
tools.description: Generate a React Bulk snippet for a component/platform (uses the docs example when no options are given).

tools.name: rbk_generate_theme_patch
tools.description: Generate a theme patch from a design intent.

tools.name: rbk_validate_usage
tools.description: Validate React Bulk usage (imports, props, color tokens) in source code or a project path.

tools.name: rbk_platform_matrix
tools.description: Return web/native support matrix by component, including platform-specific props.

instructions:
React Bulk: call rbk_get_core_usage_guide before writing code and rbk_validate_usage after.
Short spacing aliases (m/p/i/t/b/l/r + x/y/h/v, e.g. px, mt) multiply numbers by theme.shape.spacing (4); g/gx/gy by gap * spacing (16). Full names (padding, margin, gap…) are raw px: p={8} = 32px, padding={8} = 8px.
Size aliases (w/h/minw/maxw/ww/hh) are raw px, true = 100%. corners multiplies theme.shape.borderRadius (6).
Box (base of every component) is a flex column by default, also on web, matching React Native layout defaults so both platforms behave the same. align/justify are alignSelf/justifySelf; center centers both axes; flex = flex: 1; values accept between/around/start/end.
Event handlers receive normalized Rbk*Event objects, the same on web and native (RbkPointerEvent for onPress, RbkInputEvent for field onChange, RbkFormEvent for Form, RbkScrollEvent, RbkLayoutEvent, RbkKeyboardEvent…). The original event is at e.nativeEvent. Value-bearing handlers also pass the value as 2nd arg: Input onChange(e, value), Checkbox/Switch (e, checked), Select (e, value, option), Form onSubmit(e, data, errors). Use onPress, not onClick.
Breakpoint keys inside style are mobile first; hidden={{ sm: true }} hides only within that range.
Import components from @react-bulk/web (web-only apps), @react-bulk/native (native-only apps) or @react-bulk/expo (Expo apps: resolves to web or native per platform, since Expo also targets web). Most hooks and helpers only from @react-bulk/core. Wrap the app in <ReactBulk>.
